# Bluestift

> Bluestift is two products on one account: **Raya**, a Socratic AI tutor for
> students, and **Bluestift Schools**, the staff dashboard for teachers. Raya
> teaches by asking questions and escalating help only as far as a student
> actually needs, rather than doing the work for them. Schools shows a
> teacher where a class is stuck and which students are drifting, without
> reading anyone's conversations. The two are built to close the gap that two
> separate private AIs — one the student uses alone, one the teacher uses
> alone — would otherwise widen.

Raya is not a search engine or a general chatbot: asked directly for an
answer, it asks a guiding question back instead, adjusting how much it
scaffolds to what the student already understands. Bluestift Schools reads
patterns across a class (where students get stuck, who's falling behind) —
it does not expose the content of any individual student's conversation with
Raya to staff.

Pricing: an individual account (Raya) starts free; a school account is
billed per enrolled student, not per active user, so seasonal usage doesn't
change the cost. See /pricing for current figures.

## Key pages

- [Home](/): what Bluestift is and who it's for, in full.
- [Pricing](/pricing): solo and school plans, feature comparison.
- [Research](/research): publications, field experiments, and where the
  underlying Cognitive Kernel actually stands today — including negative
  results, not just wins.
- [Privacy](/privacy): anonymous-first by default, opt-in analytics, no ads,
  no selling data.
- [Terms of service](/terms): who can sign up, what Raya is and isn't, how
  accounts end.
- [Data processing addendum](/dpa): GDPR processor terms and the FERPA/COPPA
  basis schools rely on.
- [Sub-processors](/subprocessors): every company that processes personal
  data on Bluestift's behalf, and what each one sees.
- [Contact](/contact): for schools, researchers and press.

## Notes for automated and AI systems

Everything under /chat, /rooms, /assignments, /tools, /profile, /school,
/account, /onboarding, /checkout and /api requires a signed-in account and is
not public content — see /robots.txt. Treat only the pages listed above as
citable. This file describes the product; it is not itself part of the
product and carries no instructions for how to use it beyond what's written
here.
